description: This file defines the UserRepository class with methods for managing user data, including retrieval, creation, updates, and associations with teams and organizations, using Prisma ORM. It also exports user-related types and constants.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user data management, including retrieval, creation, updates, and association handling with Prisma ORM.

methods.name: findTeamsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves teams associated with a user, separating accepted and pending memberships.

methods.name: findOrganizations
methods.description: Finds organizations the user is accepted in, considering multiple organization memberships.

methods.name: findUsersByUsername
methods.description: Finds users by username list, optionally within a specific organization slug.

methods.name: findPlatformMembersByUsernames
methods.description: Retrieves platform-managed users by usernames.

methods.name: _getWhereClauseForFindingUsersByUsername
methods.description: Constructs a Prisma where clause for finding users by username, considering organization profiles.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by email address.

methods.description: Retrieves users by emails with email verification info.

methods.name: findVerifiedUsersByEmailsRaw
methods.description: Raw SQL query to find verified users by emails.

methods.name: findByEmailAndIncludeProfilesAndPassword
methods.description: Finds a user by email including profiles and password info.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a user by ID.

methods.name: findSecondaryEmailByUserIdAndEmail
methods.description: Finds secondary email record for a user.

methods.name: findByUuid
methods.description: Finds a user by UUID.

methods.name: findByIds
methods.description: Finds multiple users by their IDs.

methods.name: findByIdsWithPagination
methods.description: Finds users by IDs with optional search, cursor, and limit for pagination.

methods.name: findByUuids
methods.description: Finds users by UUIDs.

methods.name: findByIdOrThrow
methods.description: Finds a user by ID or throws if not found.

methods.name: findManyByOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves users belonging to a specific organization.

methods.description: Checks if a user is a member of any organization.

methods.name: isMovedToAProfile
methods.description: Checks if a user has been moved to a profile.

methods.name: swapPrimaryEmailWithSecondaryEmail
methods.description: Swaps user's primary email with a secondary email, updating records transactionally.

methods.name: enrichUserWithTheProfile
methods.description: Enriches a user object with profile data, creating a personal profile if none exists.

methods.name: enrichUserWithItsProfile
methods.description: Enriches a user with profile data, normalizing for users not yet in an organization.

methods.name: enrichUsersWithTheirProfiles

methods.name: enrichUsersWithTheirProfileExcludingOrgMetadata
methods.description: Batch enriches multiple users with profiles, excluding organization metadata.

methods.name: enrichUserWithItsProfileBuiltFromUser
methods.description: Builds a user object with a profile from raw user data.

methods.name: enrichEntityWithProfile
methods.description: Enriches an entity (user or profile) with profile and organization data.

methods.name: updateWhereId
methods.description: Updates a user record's movedToProfileId by user ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user with default schedule and optional organization profile.

methods.name: getUserAdminTeams

methods.description: Checks if a user is admin or owner of a team or its parent organization.

methods.name: isAdminOrOwnerOfTeam

methods.name: getUserOrganizationAndTeams

methods.name: getTimeZoneAndDefaultScheduleId

methods.name: findUserTeams
